description: Regular engine oil replacement to maintain lubrication and engine health
Replacement of the engine oil filter to remove contaminants from the oil
Replacement of the engine air filter to ensure clean air intake
Replacement of the fuel filter to protect the engine from fuel impurities
Inspection of brake pads, rotors, calipers, and brake fluid levels
Replacement of worn brake pads to maintain braking performance
Rotating tires between positions to ensure even wear and extend tire life
Full replacement of one or more tires due to wear or damage
Visual and pressure inspection of all tires including spare
Testing battery voltage, charge capacity, and terminal condition
Comprehensive inspection of engine components, belts, and hoses
Replacement of transmission / gearbox oil to prevent wear and overheating
Inspection and top-up of engine coolant / antifreeze level
Renewal of vehicle insurance policy before expiry
Renewal of vehicle registration / road tax with the traffic authority
Official or internal roadworthiness inspection of the vehicle
Verification that the GPS tracking device is functioning and transmitting correctly
